item.text:
The report now documents sixteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F16: a follower accepts a proposal with a missing predecessor**. In [Follower.processPacket](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/Follower.java:161), a non-consecutive zxid only produces a warning, after which `fzk.logRequest(...)` is called unconditionally. A fresh follower with `lastQueued == 0` therefore queued a zxid-5 proposal while expecting zxid 1. The repro observed:

```
WARN ... Got zxid 0x5 expected 0x1
AssertionError: a proposal with a missing predecessor was queued for logging
```

Reproduction: [GapProposalRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/gap_proposal/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/GapProposalRepro.java).

The fifteen earlier findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leakage, malformed transaction handling, truncation/recovery issues, epoch initialization failure, oracle election/revalidation defects, duplicate-proposal handling, and the storage-layer duplicate-zxid append. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
